title: 'The Murders in the Rue Morgue,' by Edgar Allen Poe, Part Two (2/3)
titleZh: 愛倫坡《莫爾格街兇殺案》第二部分 (2/3)
summaryZh: 搜索的人在四樓破門而入，發現一間血跡斑斑、被翻得亂七八糟的房間。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — American Stories

sentences.text: The group searched, but found nothing, until the fourth floor.
sentences.zh: 這群人一路搜查，什麼也沒找到，直到四樓。

sentences.text: There, they came to a door, locked from the inside.
sentences.zh: 在那裡，他們來到一扇從裡面鎖上的門前。

sentences.text: Before them was a bloody, horror scene.
sentences.zh: 眼前是一片血腥恐怖的景象。

sentences.text: The room was in total disorder.
Broken chairs and tables, and the mattress pulled from the bed.
sentences.zh: 破掉的桌椅，還有被從床上拖下來的床墊。

sentences.text: On the walls, the floor, the bed.
A sharp knife lay on the floor in a pool of blood.
sentences.zh: 一把鋒利的刀躺在地上的血泊裡。

sentences.text: In front of the fireplace was a clump of long, gray hair.
sentences.zh: 壁爐前有一撮長長的灰白頭髮。

sentences.text: It seemed to have been pulled straight out of a head.
sentences.zh: 看起來像是硬生生從頭皮上扯下來的。

sentences.text: On the floor were four pieces of gold.
And two bags containing a large amount of money, in gold.
sentences.zh: 以及兩個裝著大筆金幣的袋子。

sentences.text: Clothes had been thrown around the room.
sentences.zh: 衣服被扔得滿房間都是。
